decisions.reason: The hierarchical search bundle has had no visible presence since 2018 and carries little commitment, but as a cheap extension of the core platform the firm can still justify keeping it.

VueTOC was an experimental mobile component announced only once, it has not been visible since, and it is likely to be folded into other offerings, so its resources are better used in the core platform.
The GIS platform is the flagship product line and central to the firm's announced direction, so the heavy investment and public commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.
The field data capture software has its own page and fits the core offer, and its weaker visibility can be attributed to temporary adoption delays during the pandemic years.
